landmark

Az Elephant Head egy hatalmas víz alatti sziklaképződmény a Mu Ko Similan Nemzeti Parkban, amely az átúszható barlangjai miatt népszerű a búvárok körében.
Elephant Head este o formațiune masivă de bolovani subacvatici din Parcul Național Mu Ko Similan, populară printre scafandri pentru tunelurile sale.
Elephant Head is a massive underwater boulder formation in the Mu Ko Similan National Park, popular among scuba divers for its swim-throughs.
Deep Six
natural

A Deep Six egy festői kilátóhely a Mu Ko Similan Nemzeti Parkban, amely az Andamán-tengerbe szakadó meredek sziklafalairól ismert.

Deep Six is a scenic observation point within the Mu Ko Similan National Park, known for its steep rocky drop-offs into the Andaman Sea.

recreational

Ao Nguang Chang is a pristine sandy beach nestled along the forested coastline of the Mu Ko Similan National Park.

recreational

Hat Lek is a secluded, compact sandy beach surrounded by the dense tropical vegetation of the Mu Ko Similan National Park.

recreational

Nui Beach
recreational
